# Leslie Moore

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-eight  <sub>[v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c40 P11](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds (The West farm)  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher; housekeeper and board-provider; trained nurse in perspective  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c38 P20](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0020)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Dick Moore  <sub>[v4 c6 P29](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0029), [v4 c10 P11](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0011)</sub>; Mrs. Owen Ford  <sub>[v4 c38 P15](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Leslie possesses an extraordinary and striking beauty with a magnificent, erect figure and a springy step. She has milk-white skin, blue eyes, crimson lips, and long, brilliant golden hair that reaches to her feet when unbraided. Often wearing a dark or plain dress, she frequently accents her attire with a splash or girdle of crimson.

_Sources: [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 c10 P5](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0005), [v4 c11 P10](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0010), [v4 c12 P15](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0015), [v4 c23 P26](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0026)_

## Personality

Intense, proud, and deeply clannish, Leslie was hardened by years of tragic misfortune into a cold, aloof, and sometimes bitter reserve. Beneath her defensive mantle lies a warm, vivid, and deeply loving nature that blossoms in the company of true friends. She possesses a keen wit, a rich capacity for joy, and a firm, old-fashioned sense of duty and honor. Though once tormented by envy of those with happier lives, she possesses the courage to acknowledge her faults and seek reconciliation.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P30](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0030), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c21 P11](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0011), [v4 c21 P27](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0027), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c27 P40](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0040)_

## History

Leslie grew up on the West farm in Four Winds. After the tragic deaths of her brother and father, she excelled at Queen's Academy and took up teaching. At sixteen, her mother pressured her into marrying Dick Moore to save their mortgaged farm. Following her mother's death, Dick went to sea and was eventually brought back by Captain Jim as a brain-damaged invalid, whom Leslie dutifully nursed for twelve years. Upon the arrival of Anne and Gilbert Blythe at Four Winds, Leslie formed a deep, albeit initially troubled, friendship with Anne. Encouraged by Dr. Gilbert Blythe, Leslie took her husband to a Montreal hospital for a brain operation. The surgery restored the man's memory, revealing that he was actually Dick's lookalike cousin, George Moore, and that the real Dick Moore had died years earlier in Cuba. Granted her freedom, Leslie returned to Four Winds and eventually confessed her mutual love for writer Owen Ford, whom she agreed to marry.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P15](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0015), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c21 P28](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0028), [v4 c30 P15](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0015), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c33 P9](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0009), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank West and Rose Elliott of Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Tragically lost her younger brother Kenneth in an accident at age twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's body after his suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy and became a schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Coerced into marrying Dick Moore at sixteen to prevent the foreclosure of her mother's home  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c10 P48](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0048)</sub>
- Cared for twelve years for an invalid whom she believed to be her brain-damaged husband, Dick Moore  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>

## Quotes

> I had a house of dreams once—but it was a palace.  <sub>[v4 c10 P27](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0027)</sub>

> If we are to be friends you must call me Leslie.  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

> I ENVY Anne, and I’d envy her even if she had died! She was a mother for one beautiful day. I’d gladly give my life for THAT!  <sub>[v4 c19 P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028)</sub>

> I am your friend and you are mine, for always. Such a friend as I never had before.  <sub>[v4 c21 P48](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0048)</sub>
